$comment: Registry of ALL package.json `overrides`/`resolutions`, split by intent. `security` = transitive pins added to remediate a vulnerability; the daily security-maintenance workflow re-resolves each and auto-prunes any the graph no longer needs (so they MUST carry a safeFloor). `intentional` = deliberate, permanent pins (version alignment, singletons) that are documented but NEVER auto-removed. The pinned VERSION is not stored here - package.json is the single source of truth; this file only records intent. `audit:overrides:check` (PR CI) requires every package.json override to appear in exactly one bucket, that security floors are >= safeFloor, and that overrides==resolutions. See scripts/audit-overrides.ts.

ws.reason: A transitive consumer pulled ws 8.20.1 into the production image; 8.21.0 is the first fixed release.
ws.removeWhen: No dependency resolves ws below 8.21.0 without this override.

minimatch.reason: monaco-languageclient -> vscode-languageclient@9.0.1 pins minimatch ^5.1.0, pulling the vulnerable 5.1.9 into the bundled Monaco editor. 10.x is the fixed line; the matching API used (minimatch(path, pattern)) is unchanged.
minimatch.removeWhen: vscode-languageclient (via monaco-languageclient) widens its minimatch range to a fixed release, or no dependency resolves minimatch below 10.2.5.

postcss-selector-parser.reason: Transitive build-tooling dependency (postcss) pulled 6.1.2; 7.1.4 is the fixed release. Build-time only (not in the production runtime image).
postcss-selector-parser.removeWhen: No dependency resolves postcss-selector-parser below 7.1.4 without this override.

dompurify.advisory: Added in #210 (extend Trivy scope to MEDIUM and bump vulnerable deps): DOMPurify sanitizer-bypass class.
dompurify.reason: DOMPurify is the HTML sanitizer; 3.4.3 is the pinned fixed release. Confirm the exact advisory ID from #210 if refining.
dompurify.removeWhen: No dependency resolves dompurify below 3.4.3 without this override.

esbuild.advisory: esbuild dev-server request-exposure class; pinned to the patched 0.28.x line.
esbuild.reason: Forces every consumer onto a non-vulnerable esbuild line. Confirm the exact advisory ID if refining.
esbuild.removeWhen: No dependency resolves esbuild below 0.28.1 without this override.

yaml.advisory: Pinned to the non-vulnerable yaml 2.9.x line.
yaml.reason: Forces every consumer onto a fixed yaml release. Confirm the exact advisory ID if refining.
yaml.removeWhen: No dependency resolves yaml below 2.9.0 without this override.

adm-zip.reason: Auto-remediated by Security Maintenance: adm-zip 0.5.10 had fixable advisories; pinned to the fixed 0.x line.
adm-zip.removeWhen: No dependency resolves below 0.6.0 without this override.

undici.reason: Auto-remediated by Security Maintenance: undici 7.28.0 had fixable advisories; pinned to the fixed 7.x line.
undici.removeWhen: No dependency resolves below 7.29.0 without this override.

brace-expansion.removeWhen: No dependency resolves below 5.0.12 without this override.

fast-uri.removeWhen: No dependency resolves below 3.1.8 without this override.

sharp.removeWhen: No dependency resolves below 0.35.5 without this override.

shell-quote.removeWhen: No dependency resolves below 1.11.0 without this override.

react.reason: Exact single React version across the workspace - Module Federation requires one React instance shared by host and remotes.

react-dom.reason: Pinned with react to keep a single ReactDOM instance (MFE singleton).

drizzle-orm.reason: Aligned to a single Drizzle ORM version across the workspace.

drizzle-kit.reason: Pinned below 1.0 to a drizzle-kit range compatible with the pinned drizzle-orm.

@astrojs/markdown-remark.reason: Deduped to a single version so astro-mermaid resolves the copy that exports isUnifiedProcessor; a stale transitive 7.1.x (from @astrojs/mdx) otherwise broke the docs build with 'isUnifiedProcessor is not a function'.

@types/node.reason: Bun 1.4's bun-types depends on @types/node with a wildcard range. The lock refresh otherwise combines Node 12, 18, 20, 24, and 26 ambient declarations; that mixed graph breaks tsgo's event-emitter types. Keep all consumers on the current Node 26 type line so the declarations merge consistently.
